candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway /v1/checkout; checkout 502s are downstream failures originating at payment, not gateway-local faults.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 but no payment-side logs or metrics were admitted, so the internal payment failure mode is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All checkout 502s trace to order returning 502, which traces to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway metrics show only /v1/checkout 502s with low latency, consistent with fast downstream error propagation. Payment-side evidence is absent, so the specific payment fault is bounded but not fully substantiated.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics covering the 503 window
Order service logs for the 502 propagation path
